mapper.select: SELECT record_id FROM public.nocode_detail_position WHERE object_id = CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND detail_id = CAST(#{detail} AS bigint) AND parent_id = #{parent} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY position, id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_detail_position SET deleted = 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = now() WHERE object_id = CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND detail_id = CAST(#{detail} AS bigint) AND parent_id = #{parent} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO public.nocode_detail_position(object_id, detail_id, parent_id, record_id, position, creator, updater) VALUES
(CAST(#{object} AS bigint), CAST(#{detail} AS bigint), #{parent}, #{row}, #{position}, #{actor}, #{actor})
ON CONFLICT(object_id, detail_id, parent_id, record_id) DO UPDATE SET position = EXCLUDED.position, deleted = 0, updater = EXCLUDED.updater, update_time = now()
